name: Sentinelles grippe France
attribution: Réseau Sentinelles, Inserm / Sorbonne Université, sentiweb.fr
note: Réseau Sentinelles (Inserm, Sorbonne Université): weekly incidence per 100 000 of influenza-like illness in France since 1984. thresholdValue is a watch threshold chosen here, not the network's epidemic threshold, which it publishes each season in its bulletin.

name: Sentinelles grippe regions
attribution: Réseau Sentinelles, Inserm / Sorbonne Université, sentiweb.fr

name: FluNet grippe monde
attribution: WHO FluNet (GISRS), who.int/tools/flunet, used under WHO's terms for data; WHO does not endorse this project
note: WHO FluNet (GISRS): influenza-positive specimens reported each ISO week by about 190 countries, world total, positivity rate, countries reporting, and the six WHO regions. Rows pulled from the public API (xmart-api-public.who.int/FLUMART/VIW_FNT) on 2026-10-30 and turned into readings by bench/make-flunet-readings.js. The last weeks are always incomplete: countries report late. The readings file is NOT committed: WHO's terms for its datasets (who.int/about/policies/publishing/data-policy/terms-and-conditions) restrict use to public health purposes and exclude any use in conjunction with the promotion of a commercial enterprise, so each user fetches the rows and builds watch/flunet-monde.json with bench/make-flunet-readings.js (the fetch command is at the top of that file).

name: Essais vaccins tuberculose
attribution: ClinicalTrials.gov, U.S. National Library of Medicine
note: ClinicalTrials.gov: every registered study of a tuberculosis vaccine and its status. A status that changes (recruiting, completed, terminated) is a variation.

name: Relevés d'une sonde (exemple)
note: The generic format any probe or instrument export can take: an array of snapshots, oldest first. Replace the path with your own export.
